findings.issue: בֹּהַק is a common noun (H933, masculine singular absolute), not a name; bohaq leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
כֵּהוֹת (H3544, feminine plural) is dim, faint, or darkish; oscuras takes the dark end and can read as a second color next to blancas.

notes: Number, articles, construct piel, verbless הוא, and qal perfect brotó otherwise match the tokens.
